name: A warning at Stormwind Keep

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Bolvar plans renewed action; Katrana opposes the report without being named its patron.
description: Jaina sends the findings to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. He accepts the seriousness of her report and plans renewed action against the Defias until the king is returned. Lady Katrana Prestor urges him to turn elsewhere, dismissing the charge as speculation. Her objection is part of the record; it does not identify her as the patron or prove a connection to the disappearance. Bolvar asks that Jaina hear his thanks.
